title: `dev` hardcodes `LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=true`, making the dormant (day-one mainnet) leg unreachable through the only entry point developers run — partially reverting the story-079 fix for ledger L-03

description:
Ledger entry L-03 (12bcca3b617c, fix-pending) was fixed correctly at the contract-script layer: `DeployMocks.s.sol:398` now reads `armKenduPromo = vm.envOr("LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU", true)` and a full dormant leg exists (:400, :1631-1639, :2044-2061, :2193-2199). That is exactly what story 079 mandated, armed-by-default included. This delta then added `LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=true` to the `dev` key itself.

A command-prefix assignment overrides the inherited environment, so the toggle is now inert from outside. Verified: `LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=false bash -c 'LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=true sh -c "echo \$LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU"'` -> `true` (control without the prefix -> `false`). A developer following the instruction the script itself prints cannot make it take effect.

The script contradicts the entry point in three places. `DeployMocks.s.sol:210` NatSpec: "Set LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=false to boot the DORMANT chain instead — the state mainnet actually ships on day one, and the one state this script could previously never produce." `:1634` prints at the end of EVERY `dev` run: "Set LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=false to boot the DORMANT (day-one mainnet) chain" (captured verbatim in the live run log). And `:1984`: "Do not read the armed leg's behaviour as a prediction of mainnet's." `dev` pins the rehearsal to precisely the leg its author says must not be read as a prediction, and the remedy the script advertises does not work.

This is NOT an incomplete fix of L-03 as filed — the fix landed complete. It is a correct fix partially reverted one layer up, by one of the nine untagged commits in this delta.
impact: The day-one mainnet configuration (`promoToken == address(0)`, `promoRewardBalance == 0`, phUSD/Kendu streams whitelisted-but-unregistered) is unreachable through `npm run dev` without editing package.json. Story 076 specifies mainnet ships with 'No `startPromotion` call anywhere'; the shape the UI must actually render gracefully on day one is therefore never exercised by the entry point anyone runs, while the divergent armed shape is. Local-only, so no funds are at risk — but it degrades the evidentiary value of the rehearsal and it silently undoes work a human triaged as fix-pending, which is exactly the class the ledger's INCOMPLETE-FIX rule exists to catch. Propose the L-03 ledger entry be held at fix-pending pending this revert, NOT flipped to fixed.
attackPath: Not an attack. `dev` prefixes `LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=true`; a command-prefix assignment overrides the inherited environment, so `vm.envOr`'s toggle is unreachable through the only entry point developers run.
The armed leg is always rehearsed; the dormant leg that matches day-one mainnet never is.
recommendation: Delete `LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=true` from the `dev` key and let `vm.envOr`'s default supply the armed leg (identical behaviour, toggle restored). If an explicit armed default is wanted at the npm layer, add a second key (`dev:dormant` with `LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=false`) rather than pinning the only one. Add a rehearsal obligation that BOTH legs are booted before a mainnet cutover, since only the dormant leg matches day one.
evidence: package.json:16; DeployMocks.s.sol:210-213, :398-400, :1631-1639, :1984; live `dev` run log (sim-log.txt) line 'LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU (Kendu promo armed on PhlimboV3): true' and 'Set LOCAL_PROMO_KENDU=false to boot the DORMANT (day-one mainnet) chain'; shell-override reproduction above. Status proposal only — no ledger status flipped.
